title: CFA item set — bond duration
vignette: A portfolio manager holds a 7-year, 4% annual-pay bond. Yields fall by 50 basis points.

items.stem: If modified duration is 6.1, the approximate percentage price change is closest to:

options.rationale: Uses half the duration effect; this is the correct sign but the wrong magnitude.
Gets the duration math right but reverses the sign; falling yields raise prices.

items.explanation: Price change ≈ -modified duration × change in yield. A 50 bp fall is -0.005, so -6.1 × -0.005 = +0.0305.

showYourWork.prompt: Compute the modified duration from the bond's Macaulay duration, then explain why the price change is positive.
rubric: Uses the correct sign for the yield change
Reports the result with units (percentage price change)
